subject: Shared MAP + week0 draft for Orchid.AI pilot
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Soto <emma.soto@orchidai.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@orchidai.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Shared MAP + week0 draft for Orchid.AI pilot

Emma / Liam —

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. Per our conversation I attached a lightweight MAP scaffold and a one-page week0 checklist to get dev and security into a quick aligned sprint. The goal is to reduce uncertainty on integration work and acceptance criteria before you spin up the pilot.

What I shared:
- MAP_Template_Orchid_Draft.gdoc (link in body) — one page MAP with stakeholders, acceptance gates, and owners.
- week0-onboarding-checklist.xlsx — practical tasks: API keys, sample dataset, network allowlist, and access to a sandbox model.

Ask: could you confirm the internal stakeholders who will own infra and data validation? Also, are you available for a 30-min MAP walkthrough on Thursday morning PST? I’ll bring Jasmine (solutions engineer) to map the technical owners and Priyom (CS) to align success metrics.

Draft link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-orchid-map-prototype
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7862/ORC-2026-07-03

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm stakeholders by Wed EOD.
2) We run a 30-min MAP walkthrough Thurs 10:00–10:30 PT.
3) We lock week0 checklist and ship initial sandbox access by the end of next week.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

Subject: Re: Shared MAP + week0 draft for Orchid.AI pilot

Thanks Marcus — this looks helpful. A couple quick clarifications before Thursday: 

1) Stakeholders — I’ll own product and acceptance criteria.
2) Security/infra owner — Liam will own the allowlist and VPN setup (he’s cc’d on your original).
3) Success metric — can you add a row in the MAP for inference cost SLO (tokens/sec and daily spend cap)? We need a clear guardrail for the pilot.

Thursday at 10:00 PT works.

One more ask: our procurement team wants to see an abbreviated timeline that shows expected milestones to MCT (Minimum Commercial Threshold) — can you add a simple close timeline (weeks to MCT) in the doc during the walkthrough?

—Emma

Head of Product, Orchid.AI

Jasmine / Priyom —

Forwarding Emma’s reply. Short notes:
- Add a one-line cost SLO row under success metrics (tokens/sec and daily spend cap). Jasmine, can you propose two options (conservative / aggressive) we can present Thursday?
- I’ll add a one-slide close timeline to the MAP during the walkthrough: 0–2w sandbox validation, 2–6w pilot, 6–12w MCT. Keep it explicit that MCT requires integrated telemetry and a 95th percentile latency SLO.
- Priyom, can you prepare a one-paragraph description of what MCT looks like from a Redwood success perspective (2–3 measurable acceptance items)? We’ll paste it into the MAP.

Also pinging Jasmine to bring any infra preflight notes for our sandbox (network ports, sample payload size).
